# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 41,531 across 2 platforms (youtube: 35,978, instagram: 5,553).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-09-06.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.3%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.0%.
- youtube: positive 63.2%, neutral 21.1%, negative 15.7%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.493, neutral 0.495, positive 0.505 (spread 0.012).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: agent, new, think, real - 21,169 posts.
- T5: business, help, build, digitalmarketing - 5,123 posts.
- T10: time, save, save time, real time - 1,492 posts.
- T8: easy, understand, easy understand, simple - 1,448 posts.
- T7: smart, rich, broke, dumb - 1,221 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T0: agent, new, think, real (+1.37 pts).
- Rising: T8: easy, understand, easy understand, simple (+0.8 pts).
- Rising: T1: wish, understandable, clear understandable, understandable wish (+0.49 pts).
- Declining: T10: time, save, save time, real time (-1.0 pts).
- Declining: T5: business, help, build, digitalmarketing (-3.45 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 7,694 posts.
- AI Agents - 5,904 posts.
- Automation - 4,440 posts.
- Startup - 4,171 posts.
- SEO - 3,291 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=11, UMass coherence -0.573 (more coherent than LDA).
